name: RCD-Signature Audit
description: Dedicated reproducibility deposit for the Cell Systems manuscript "Signature is not pathway: 99.1% of published regulated-cell-death gene signatures are indistinguishable from expression-matched random gene sets". Contents: the complete benchmark package (frozen 169-entry registry with full provenance, locked and validated audit engines, null-construction code, pre-registration + amendment, raw harvest layer, self-checker v3 with relative-pool positioning, seed-deterministic Signature Audit Certificate generator, pip packaging + CI, worked GSE63042 example), the full source_data tree with all audit and optimization-round tables (FDR resolution re-analysis at 100,000 draws: 1,606/1,608 fail; below-chance at clustering-robust units 10/402, p = 8.9e-3; signal-injection power calibration with detection floor lambda 0.5-0.75; positive controls; journal-tier stratification; 55-set non-RCD transfer panel with the consolidation gradient 17.5% > 4.4% > 0.87%; claim-prevalence scan of all 162 harvested full texts; weight pilot and prospective factorial; predictability at out-of-fold AUROC 0.835; refinement travel test; two prospective post-freeze live cases, 16/16 cells failing), the pipeline scripts CS00-CS48, and the 162 Europe PMC full-text XMLs.
